title_en: Notice of the Multiple-Major Selection Plan for Semester 1 of the 2027 Academic Year
summary: This notice announces the selection plan for multiple majors (minor, double major, joint major, interdisciplinary major and student-designed major) for Semester 1 of the 2027 academic year, including eligibility, application periods, application method and limits on the number of multiple majors. Students from other departments applying for a double major or minor in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) must also submit a transcript and a study plan by email.
applies_to: Enrolled students (including students scheduled to return from leave) who wish to apply for a multiple major for Semester 1 of 2027 and who have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits. Applicants for a student-designed major must have an overall GPA of 3.3 or higher. Students from other departments applying for a double major or minor in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering must have a GPA of 2.7 or higher and must have completed at least two of the department's prerequisite courses. Selection is for students enrolled as of 1 March 2027; results cannot be applied to the February 2027 (2027. 2. 24.) graduation.

steps: Check the eligibility requirements and the limit on the number of multiple majors, and check the attachments for changes to these rules (the attachments were not read for this translation).

During the applicable application period, apply yourself on the portal (mysnu.ac.kr) under Academic Information [학사정보] > Changes in Academic Status [학적변동] > Application [신청] > Major/Program Application [전공/과정 신청].

If applying for a student-designed major: after applying online, submit the paper application form and related documents; approval follows submission (the place of submission is not stated in the notice).

If you are from another department and are applying for a double major or minor in Electrical and Computer Engineering: prepare one official transcript issued through certificate issuance (not the cumulative grade report), showing the department's prerequisite courses, and one study plan using the attached form [전기정보공학부 복수(부)전공_수학계획서].

Email these two documents to the department office (the address is in the original notice) by 16 October, 18:00 for a double major, or by 30 October, 18:00 for a minor. State your student number and name on each document. Documents not submitted within the period will be treated as having no intention to apply.
Wait for the selection results: double major by 23 October 2026; minor by 20 November 2026.
translation:
Notice of the Multiple-Major Selection Plan for Semester 1 of the 2027 Academic Year
Posted: 2026-09-04

We announce the selection plan for multiple majors (minor, double major, joint major, interdisciplinary major and student-designed major) for Semester 1 of the 2027 academic year. Eligible students should apply within the deadline.
In addition, the application eligibility and the number of multiple majors each student may complete are limited, so please be sure to check the changes described in the attachment. (Note: the content of the attachments was not read for this translation.)

A. Eligibility
○ Common requirement: enrolled students (including students scheduled to return from leave) who have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits.
○ Students from other departments applying for a multiple major (double major or minor) in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering [전기정보공학부]: GPA of 2.7 or higher.
○ Student-designed major: overall GPA of 3.3 or higher.

B. Application periods
○ Double major and joint major: 12 October 2026 (Mon) 09:00 to 16 October (Fri) 18:00
○ Minor, interdisciplinary major and student-designed major: 26 October 2026 (Mon) 09:00 to 30 October (Fri) 18:00

C. How to apply
○ Students apply themselves on the portal (mysnu.ac.kr) under Academic Information [학사정보] > Changes in Academic Status [학적변동] > Application [신청] > Major/Program Application [전공/과정 신청].
(However, for the student-designed major, approval is given after the online application and submission of a paper application form and related documents.)

D. Students from other departments applying for a multiple major (double major or minor) in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
○ Double major documents: one transcript (an official transcript issued through certificate issuance, not the cumulative grade report) and one study plan, to be submitted by email to the department office by 16 October (Fri), 18:00.
○ Double major selection results: scheduled to be announced by 23 October 2026 (Fri).
○ Minor documents: one transcript (an official transcript issued through certificate issuance, not the cumulative grade report) and one study plan, to be submitted by email to the department office by 30 October (Fri), 18:00.
○ Minor selection results: scheduled to be announced by 20 November 2026 (Fri).
* When submitting documents, state your student number and name. Example: Transcript: "2025-** [Name] 성적"; Study plan: "2025-** [Name]".
(The email address is given in the original notice.)
※ If the documents (transcript and study plan) are not submitted within the submission period, you will be considered to have no intention to apply.
※ Selected multiple majors will be reflected in academic records: scheduled for 15 January 2027 (Fri).
※ Multiple majors for Semester 1 of 2027 are selected for students enrolled as of 1 March 2027. Therefore, the Semester 1 2027 selection results cannot be applied to the late graduation (24 February 2027).

E. Criteria for students of other majors applying for a multiple major (double major or minor) in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
- Eligibility: GPA of 2.7 or higher, and completion of at least two of the department's prerequisite major courses: Physics 2 [물리학 2] (or Advanced Physics 2 [고급물리학2]), Engineering Mathematics 1 [공학수학 1], Engineering Mathematics 2 [공학수학 2], and Computer Concepts and Practice [컴퓨터의 개념 및 실습].
- Documents: transcript (with the department's prerequisite major courses marked); study plan (using the attached form).

F. Important notes
○ If you are selected for a double major or minor in the same major as a multiple major you are already taking, the multiple major you are already taking will be cancelled automatically.
○ You cannot be selected for both a double major and a minor in the same major in the same academic year/semester. If you are not selected for the double major, you may apply for the minor.
○ Limit on the number of multiple majors per student:
- Maximum number of multiple majors you may apply for per semester: 3
- Number of multiple majors one person may complete: 6
- Number of multiple majors you may apply for, by situation (as of the application date):
# Taking 6 or more multiple majors: cannot apply
# Taking 5 multiple majors: may apply for 1
# Taking 4 multiple majors: may apply for 2
# Taking 3 or fewer multiple majors: may apply for 3

* Enquiries: the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
